_note: The suite shell's manifest, read by packaging/module-info.ps1 (as module.json is for a module) and by platform/scripts/build-data.ps1, which turns it into data/suite-data.js for the home page. The version is not here: it is the suite's, in shared/version.js. 'product' must match js/product.js. 'modules' lists the tools on the home page, in display order; 'navLabel' is the one-word label under the tool's icon in the suite's side rail; each tool's name comes from its own modules/<id>/module.json. 'tour' says how to open the tool's guided tour: 'entry' is a page of its own (built into the suite file separately), 'launch' opens the tool's own page with those launch options (see shared/host-bridge.js).

modules.summary: Assess a site, system, product or supplier against IEC 62443, NCSC CAF, NIS2, NIST, CIS, ONR SyAPs, the EU CRA and more.
modules.useWhen: To measure a site, system, product or supplier against a standard and report the gaps. One project file can hold several assessments for a customer, such as this year's and a re-assessment.

modules.summary: Run an IEC 62443-3-2 risk assessment and set a target security level for each zone and conduit.
modules.useWhen: Before a 62443-3-3 assessment, to set the targets it is measured against. Export the risk context file and import it into that assessment.
